components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (for example MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it is combined with the last name to form the owner's
            salutation.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form); when structured address fields are
            supplied they take precedence. On output this is the composed address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations
            expanded). An owner is valid when it supplies either a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or a flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (unit, suite, etc.). Normalized the same way as 'addressLine1'; when
            present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized to E.164 form:
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and is the value stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional; when
            supplied it is used to derive the owner's age band relative to the
            registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099), fall within
            that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used when creating an owner. When another owner already
            has the same last name and address (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) the create is normally rejected with 409; setting
            this flag to true acknowledges the shared household and allows the create.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path for this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the title and last name
                separated by a single space (for example 'DR who'), or just the
                last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region derived from the owner's
                postcode/city, the 2-digit fiscal year, the first eight upper-case
                hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name, and a single Luhn check digit
                computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW27A1B2C3D45'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registration date. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named
                after the calendar year in which it ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same
                household. It is assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' set to true and another owner already has the
                same last name and address; both owners then share this value.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first and last names (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, the raw score from which the
                membership level is derived: starting at 0, plus 2 when an email
                address is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3
                when the owner's tenure (the number of fiscal years elapsed since
                the registration date, the fiscal year starting on 1 July) is at
                least 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more. A new owner joining an existing household is capped
                at one above the current maximum membership level among their

I implemented the `riskFlag` field on the owner read model so that `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns it.

     - the owner is a possible duplicate (`possibleDuplicate` set at create time),
     - the email domain is **disposable-adjacent**, or
     - the city is over its soft capacity (`capacityWarning`, i.e. the city held ≥40 owners at creation);
     otherwise `false`.
   - `isDisposableAdjacentEmail()` flags emails whose domain shares a known disposable provider's base label (e.g. `mailinator`) via a subdomain (`x.mailinator.com`) or a different TLD (`mailinator.net`) — cases the exact-match create-time blocklist deliberately doesn't reject. A missing/empty email yields `false`.

The three conditions reuse the existing computed-and-stored fields (`possibleDuplicate`, `capacityWarning`) plus the stored email, so `riskFlag` reflects the state at creation time, consistent with the surrounding rules. The new `Cp58Tests` (normal owner → `riskFlag` false) passes, as do all other existing tests.
